An unforgettable message.There is no choice but to search for answers.Enter the visually realistic and action-filled world of PLAN 8.Official WebsiteFacebookYoutubeX Notices Global Release Time and Pre-load Notice Mar 12, 2026, 09:00 (UTC) Facebook X It’s almost time! Crimson Desert launches simultaneously worldwide on all platforms next week. And if you’ve pre-ordered Crimson Desert on the PlayStation Store, Xbox Store, Microsoft Store, or Steam, you’ll be able to pre-load the game starting 48 hours before launch on those platforms. Check the specific pre-load and release dates and times for your time zone below. If you experienced any issues with your pre-download, please contact your platform’s support team.
